about: Everything that extension/manifest.json may ask the browser for, each with its reason. scripts/check-manifest.mjs fails when the manifest asks for more or for less: Chrome disables an installed extension after an update that asks for a new permission or host, until someone accepts the new warning in chrome://extensions, and a board display in kiosk mode then stops switching without a word. Add an entry here only with its justification in the store listing of every language, store/listing.<code>.md, and a note in the changelog that the update asks for it. data_collection_permissions names the data that the add-on sends off the computer, which Firefox shows at the install as browser_specific_settings.gecko.data_collection_permissions declares it (decision 0012).

permissions.storage: Keeps the saved accounts, their sessions, the settings of the button and of the venue mode, and the salted hashes of the venue PINs on this computer.
permissions.alarms: Renews the parked sessions in the background, so they still work days later, and in the venue mode looks once a minute whether the display should return after a break.
permissions.scripting: Runs the extension's own content.js again in the Autodarts tabs that are open when the extension is installed or updated, and in an Autodarts tab whose content script doesn't answer, so a display in kiosk mode keeps its button and switches without a reload.
permissions.unlimitedStorage: Keeps the key that seals the saved sessions and passwords in the extension's IndexedDB from being evicted when the disk runs low; without it Chrome may delete that storage, and every parked account would have to sign in again. It shows no warning at the install.

host_permissions.https://play.autodarts.com/*: The Autodarts page: content.js reads and writes the session there, shows the button of the switcher, and the worker finds the Autodarts tabs by their address with it.
host_permissions.https://api.autodarts.com/*: The sign-in service of Autodarts: renewing a session, signing in with a remembered password and ending a session.

web_accessible_resources.switcher.html: The switcher that the button lays over the Autodarts page, a page of the extension in a frame, so the scripts of the page can't read the accounts out of it.

data_collection_permissions.authenticationInfo: The session tokens of the saved accounts, and a remembered username with its password, go to the sign-in service of Autodarts, api.autodarts.com, to renew a session, to sign in again and to end a session. They go nowhere else: not to the developer, not to anyone else, and the extension sends no usage data, no error reports and no other data.
